_meta.contents: textured choice battery: 16 values x 5 pairs. Rebalanced vs pilot baselines (ceiling values rebuilt so the non-favored option carries genuine appeal absent the context sentence); kindness & care rebuilt under the orthogonality rule (texture never loads on the probed value); texture_dimension declared per pair; value_favored counterbalanced ~2-3 per side within each value; {role} fixed within a pair's variants; 'self' flagged where present.
_meta.status: AWAITING RESEARCHER CURATION, then indifference/rebalance screens drive one rewrite iteration
_meta.orthogonality_note: author_rule_pass asserted for every pair; rater_score and model_indifference_p filled by screens. Pairs where v1 texture failed the rule are marked rebuilt_from_v1.
_meta.counterbalance: swap_at_freeze: true means the freezer swaps option_a/option_b AND flips value_favored when composing the frozen set (researcher decision 2026-07-09). Post-swap favored patterns are 2-3 per side for every value. Validator must re-check counterbalance and duplicate-options AFTER applying swaps.
_meta.role_policy: TIERED run-all v2 (tiering ratified 2026-07-09; rendering-scope rule ratified 2026-07-15). role_included_base = authored/curated roles; pull and gradient estimates use ONLY these, frozen pre-run (single ratified exception: self removed from kindness/harm_avoidance base sets — definitional value-switch). Additionally rendered as pre-registered VALIDATION cells: all severity-shift predictions, non-self value-switch predictions (e.g. stranger on relational values, which tests the closeness-gradient endpoint), and a deterministic ~1/3 sample of implausible; role_predictions records each rendered validation cell's expected defect signature. NOT rendered: self value-switch cells (definitional and/or unrenderable — spec §3a rendering-scope rule), incoherent (definitional), and content-hard-exclusions. role_set = base + rendered validation (what the runner renders). IV run is non-gating; validation cells never enter pull estimates.
